import importlib.util
import json
from unittest.mock import patch
from langgraph.checkpoint.sqlite import SqliteSaver
import httpx
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("native_worker", "<owned-private-state>/deepagents-worker/examples/deepagents-omniroute/worker.py")
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
models=[]
original=module.chat_model
def tracked(env, base):
    model=original(env,base)
    models.append(model)
    return model
module.chat_model=tracked
with patch.object(httpx.Client, "send", side_effect=AssertionError("Offline check attempted network")), patch.object(httpx.AsyncClient, "send", side_effect=AssertionError("Offline check attempted network")):
    with SqliteSaver.from_conn_string("<owned-private-state>/deepagents/offline/model-fields.sqlite") as saver:
        graph=module.build_graph("<owned-private-state>/deepagents/trial-workspace", ["/skills"], saver, "OMNIROUTE_WORKER_API_KEY", "http://127.0.0.1:25371/v1")
        state=graph.get_state({"configurable": {"thread_id": "offline-field-control"}})
        assert state.values == {}
assert len(models)==2
safe=[]
for model in models:
    item={name:getattr(model,name) for name in ("model_name", "openai_api_base", "reasoning", "use_responses_api", "use_previous_response_id", "request_timeout", "max_retries")}
    assert item["openai_api_base"] == "http://127.0.0.1:25371/v1"
    assert item["reasoning"] == {"effort": "max"}
    assert item["use_responses_api"] is True
    assert item["use_previous_response_id"] is False
    safe.append(item)
print(json.dumps({"configured_model_instances":safe,"native_checkpoint_values":state.values,"http_send_calls":0},sort_keys=True))
